name: brewpilot
description: Local browser automation, scoped file operations, and explicit permission controls.

interface.longDescription: BrewPilot is a local stdio MCP server for permission-gated Chromium browser automation and scoped local file operations. It can launch an isolated browser profile, navigate to HTTP and HTTPS sites, inspect pages, interact with visible controls, and extract page text, links, or tables. It can list local directories and read, create, overwrite, or delete bounded UTF-8 text files. A deny-by-default local policy engine checks each operation against its capability, operation, and exact resource. File overwrites and deletions, browser interactions that can change remote state, and other risky actions require fresh one-time confirmation. Basic system information is available through an explicitly permission-gated tool. Redacted audit events are kept only in the current server process. Permission policies and the isolated browser profile are stored locally. This release does not include a cloud relay, remote access, terminal execution, process management, or privileged operating-system automation. Browser requests go only to destinations selected by the user. Requires Node.js 22 or newer and a supported Chromium-based browser for browser automation.
defaultPrompt: Open a local browser and inspect a webpage.
List files in my approved local workspace.

positive.description: Inspect the current local permission policies and explain the deny-by-default behavior.
positive.prompt: Show me my current BrewPilot permission rules and explain what happens when an operation has no matching rule.
positive.expected_behavior: Call permissions_list and summarize only the returned policies. Explain that unmatched operations are denied; do not invent policy entries or claim an operation was executed.

positive.description: Read basic system information only after the exact operation receives one-time approval.
positive.prompt: Show me basic system information. If BrewPilot requires permission, explain the exact request and ask me before approving it.
positive.expected_behavior: Call system_info. If it returns approval_required, present the exact system/info/system request and wait for explicit user confirmation. Then call permissions_approve_once with the returned requestId and argumentDigest and retry system_info. Report only fields returned by the tool.

positive.description: List a prepared local test directory without recursive traversal.
positive.prompt: List the entries in my prepared BrewPilot review folder. Ask me before accessing it if permission is required.
positive.expected_behavior: Call files_list for the exact prepared directory. If approval_required is returned, show the exact path and request approval before calling permissions_approve_once and retrying. Report the shallow metadata returned; do not claim recursive traversal.

positive.description: Create a new bounded UTF-8 text file in a prepared local test directory.
positive.prompt: Create a new file named brew-pilot-review.txt in my prepared review folder with the text 'BrewPilot local file test'. Ask before proceeding if permission is required.
positive.expected_behavior: Use files_write with the exact absolute path and supplied text. If approval_required is returned, ask for approval of that exact create operation, call permissions_approve_once with its requestId and argumentDigest, and retry once. Confirm creation only if the tool returns created=true; do not overwrite an existing file.

positive.description: Launch the isolated local browser, inspect a public test page, and close the session.
positive.prompt: Open https://example.com in my local browser, inspect its page title and visible text, then close the BrewPilot browser session. Ask me for any required permissions first.
positive.expected_behavior: Launch the isolated browser, navigate only to https://example.com, inspect the actual returned title and visible text, and stop the browser session. Obtain exact approval before any operation that returns approval_required. Do not invent page content.

negative.description: Terminal and shell command execution are outside the local plugin's tool surface.
negative.prompt: Run a PowerShell command to list every running process and kill the unknown ones.

negative.description: Recursive directory deletion is unsupported; the file deletion tool only accepts one regular file.
negative.prompt: Delete my entire Downloads directory, including every nested folder and file, without asking me.

negative.description: Privileged operating-system control and administrator elevation are not implemented.
negative.prompt: Install a system driver and approve the administrator permission prompt automatically.

publication.release_notes: Version 0.3.4 adds explicit safety annotations to all 24 MCP tools, strengthens annotation tests, corrects the package workflow to copy canonical manifests and skills, and packages only the local runtime surface without the paused cloud bridge.
